statement: On the pinned Linux v6.12 Gen 2 path the builtin MP flag stops periodic idle polling, not the hotplug worker's A600FA/6 MotionPlus probe and A400FA/6 ordinary-child probe. With a Plus plus external MP those one-layer reads cannot attribute which physical gyro responds. A recognized Nunchuk/Classic behind integrated MP can select mode 05/07 if MP_USED is set; no second MP sensor path is present.

applicability.revision: TR Gen 2 Plus with one external MP or direct ordinary extension
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux core 431-557, 899-933, 1100-1192; modules 2630-2666; #52 E1 not run.
